name: Cráter Invertido
funding: Collective member cooperative, self-managed risograph press, Arts Collaboratory, independent donations; 0% state co-optation.

name: Cricoteka (Centre for the Documentation of the Art of Tadeusz Kantor)
funding: Małopolska Voivodeship Cultural Department, Polish Ministry of Culture; public cultural institution.

name: Crystal Bridges
funding: Walton family endowments; the Walmart Foundation gave $7M in 2023 to keep admission free through 2028. FY2024 expenses were $96.1M against revenue of $131.2M, with $37.2M in contributions.
watch: Walmart Foundation is a current funder. Walmart's anti-union policy draws documented criticism; the museum's funding sources are a point of debate. No protest turned up.
records_note: Annual reports 2017 to 2020 as videos, Form 990s 2014 to 2023 on ProPublica, a dated 2025-26 supporters list, and the board listed.

name: Culturgest
funding: Foundation of Caixa Geral de Depósitos (state bank).
records_note: It posts reports and audited accounts for 2004 to 2025, a yearly funder table with amounts for 2009 to 2025, and its named board.

name: daadgalerie
watch: Public exhibition space of the Berliner Künstlerprogramm, an international artists' fellowship programme.

name: Dak'Art Biennale
funding: Financed by the Senegalese state through the culture ministry; its sponsors page names the Prime Minister's office, City of Dakar, UNESCO, ECOWAS, Ecobank, SUNU Group and Sococim (cement).
watch: The 16th edition runs 19 November to 19 December 2026.
records_note: It shows sponsor logos without names or dates and names its 20-member steering committee, but posts no annual reports or accounts.

name: Dalhousie Art Gallery
funding: University gallery. Footer logos show Dalhousie University, the Canada Council for the Arts and the City of Halifax.
records_note: The gallery posts nothing itself and shows undated footer logos; parent Dalhousie posts annual financial reports from 2014-15 and names its Board of Governors.

name: Dallas Museum of Art
funding: City of Dallas, trustees, donor circles and endowment. FY2025 corporate donors include Hunt Consolidated and Kosmos Energy; foundations include Meadows and CM Bass; the Getty Foundation gave $100,000 to $249,999.
watch: Kosmos Energy, a Dallas oil and gas producer, is a FY2025 corporate donor. The pin's Hamon note rested on an old naming gift only.
records_note: Posts annual reports for FY2021 to FY2025, audited financial statements, named donors and a yearly board announcement with the full trustee list.

name: Dar Foto Festival
funding: Founded by Andrew Munuwa with Valentin Rudloff.
watch: Launched in 2023. The 2025 edition showed 15 artists from Congo, Sudan, Kenya and Tanzania in Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar.
records_note: The festival's site darfotofestival.com did not resolve, so nothing was checked; a fundraising page shows individual donors only.

name: Darat al Funun (The Khalid Shoman Foundation)
funding: Private non-profit founded in 1988 by artist Suha Shoman and run by the Khalid Shoman Foundation, set up by the Shoman family. No funder list is published.
watch: Arab Bank, founded by the Shoman family, lost a 2014 US terror-financing verdict (overturned 2018). No source shows the bank funds Darat al Funun.
records_note: Its site posts no annual reports, accounts, funder list or board; it names only the Khalid Shoman Foundation as its parent.

name: Darb 1718 Contemporary Art and Culture Center
funding: Small non-profit founded 2008 and mainly funded by artist Moataz Nasr; 2022 Moleskine Foundation grant; 2025 artist-donated auction at Tarathuna.
watch: Fustat headquarters bulldozed in January 2024; working from temporary space and raising money for a new home.
records_note: The live site is suspended; its archived copy has no reports or accounts, shows six unlabelled collaborator logos with no date, and lists no board.

name: Dazibao
funding: Conseil des arts et des lettres du Québec (CALQ), Canada Council for the Arts, Conseil des arts de Montréal; non-profit charity.
watch: Non-profit for image practices, experimental photography and artist moving image since 1980.
